History of Walther

Condition: New

History of Walther is a two-volume, now out of print, is normally $145, on special for $99.95. An exclusive book detailing the rich history of Carl Walther GmbH, written by authors with unprecedented access to internal factory records, patent applications, and prototypes, the set features hundreds of rare, high-quality historical photographs and breakdown diagrams.

These volumes are highly sought after by serious firearm historians for its clarification of many historical ambiguities regarding serial number blocks, proof marks, and rare factory variants not found in other firearms guides.
